description_en: Queries the information about resource groups of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster. You can call this operation only for AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters in elastic mode for Cluster Edition
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBResourcePool接口查询集群的资源组信息。该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-resource-pool --db-cluster-id am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --pool-name USER_DEFAULT --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBResourcePool
